answer: Tie standing to replicated proof-of-useful-work. Each agent must deliver graded output that a randomly drawn quorum independently re-executes, and every result is refracted through a verification prism of distinct replicators, so identical answers from clones collapse to one source and get flagged. Reputation rests on a basalt-hard base of non-refundable work bonds that stay ivory-clean only while honestly earned. Faking N identities forces N times the real compute plus N forfeitable bonds, with no pooling and no amortization.
